answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 6392 Country: Canada Title: I once had a dream that iwas reading a book and i zoomed in to these words subhanallahi wabihamdihi subhanallahilazeem Question: assalamualaikum warahmatullahi wabarakatuhu wamagfiratuhu...i once had a dream that iwas reading a book and i zoomed in to these words subhanallahi wabihamdihi subhanallahilazeem Answer ID: 6392 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1579/1196=H/1429) It is a nice dream. The meaning of the dream is that by studying, reading out and listening Fazail Aamaal in-sha-Allah you shall get the benefits of higher books. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
